The **spring fair** is on the green, from ten until four. Entry is
free; bring a bag for the _plant stall_.

## Getting there, with [the map](https://example.com/map)

Take the 12 bus to the church.  
Walk past the hall\
and the fair is on your left.

- Stalls
  1. Plants
  2. Books, *second hand*
- Music
  - The brass band at noon
- Food

> Last year we raised enough for the roof.
>
> - Thank you to every stall holder

| Time  | What        |
| ----- | ----------- |
| 10:00 | Doors open  |
| 12:00 | Brass band  |
